Nadia: FYI QBR with Cirrus on Thurs 9:30am PT. Need: final slide deck, a 1-page exec ask, and a succinct renewal risk summary. Opening this thread for owners.

Ravi: I'll own the renewal risk slide. Quick summary: usage down 22% last 60d, trial conversion stalled. Will add heatmap and suggested mitigation.

Sam: I'll update onboarding status + open action tracker. Current blockers: API key rotation confusion, missing training sessions.

Elena: I'll grab the CS metrics and a short customer quote (asked CSM to pull). Also adding a short note on feature gaps reported.

Theo: For the exec ask, recommend two asks: 1) 60-day targeted credits for churn cohort, 2) agree to prioritized product fix queue. Short one-line bullets.

ops-bot: REMINDER: runbook must include "who to call" and escalation path. Missing contact for weekend oncall.

Nadia: Added @Theo as escalation lead and included weekend oncall contact. Uploaded deck v1: https://drive.redwood/s/qbr/cirrus_v1 (check perms).

Ravi: Drafted risk heatmap and mitigation. Suggest pairing outreach with product trial of patched workflow. Added to slide 8.

Sam: Action owners proposal: Ravi (risk + outreach plan), Sam (onboarding ops + tracker), Elena (metrics + quote), Theo (exec ask + runbook escalation), Nadia (final deck & rehearsal).

Elena: ETA for metrics + quote: EOD today.

Nadia: Great. Can we rehearse 30m before the meeting? 9:00am PT rehearsal?

Theo: 9:00 rehearsal works. I'll prep the exec ask script.

Nadia: Thanks team 44f I'll circulate final pack after rehearsal and ping execs.
